alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 16 at 5:41AM EST by NWS Northern Indiana
alerts.description:
Lingering low level moisture and light winds have been favorable
for fog formation across the region early this morning.
Visibilities will be highly variable due to the patchy nature of
the fog, but at least localized visibilities of one quarter of a
mile or less are expected through 9 AM EST. The fog is expected
to dissipate after 930 AM EST. Motorists should be prepared for
rapid changes in visibilities across short distances.
